name: All-in cost per successfully resolved event
definition: USD allocated to all eligible events divided by independently verified successful resolutions, including failed-run and human-review costs.
formula: sum(allocated_cost_usd for all eligible events) / count(distinct run_id with verified_success=true)

numerator.definition: Model, tool, sandbox, data egress, observability, human review, allocated fixed operations and risk-reserve cost in USD for every eligible event in the window.

denominator.definition: Distinct eligible events with verified_success=true; failed and escalated events are excluded only from this denominator, never from cost.

exclusions: taxes recoverable by the organization and currency conversion fees already embedded in normalized USD rates
duplicate vendor invoice lines matched by invoice_id and line_id

data_source.system: FinOps ledger joined to AgentOps event lake
data_source.query: SUM(allocated_cost_usd) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN verified_success THEN run_id END), grouped by tenant_id, scenario_id and agent_version

alert.condition: 30d all-in cost per successful event > 65.15 after minimum_sample OR daily spend > 120% of budget

confidence.decision_rule: Resample events by incident_id with 2000 replicates; PASS when denominator >= 200 and upper bound <= target.
